description: This source file defines configuration options, validators, and configurators for ADO.NET grain storage within the Orleans framework. It includes option properties such as connection string, storage initialization stage, invariants, and hash picker configuration, along with validation logic to ensure proper setup.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Options class for configuring ADO.NET-based grain storage, including connection string, init stage, invariant, and hash picker.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class that checks the validity of AdoNetGrainStorageOptions, ensuring required fields are set and valid.

classes.name: DefaultAdoNetGrainStorageOptionsHashPickerConfigurator
classes.description: Post-configuration class that sets a default hash picker if none is provided in the options.

methods.name: UseOrleans3CompatibleHasher
methods.description: Sets a legacy Orleans v3-compatible hash picker on the options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation on AdoNetGrainStorageOptions to ensure Invariant, ConnectionString, and HashPicker are properly set.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Sets a default hash picker if not already configured.
